acceptance_criteria.criterion: A source string with %s (unnumbered) shows the alert-warning block inside its editor form row
A source string with %1$s (numbered) does not show the block
A source string with no placeholders at all does not show the block
The block is only visible when the row is in the expanded/editing state
composer analyze passes with no new PHPStan errors

summary: Added unnumbered-placeholder warning block in renderTextEditorEntry() after the explanation block: conditionally renders <div class='alert alert-warning'> when hasUnnumberedPlaceholders($text->getText()) returns true. Block is inside .string-form (the collapsible form row), so only visible when the row is expanded.
Uses pt() with numbered arguments to describe which patterns are/aren't correct. Informational only, does not block saving.
